block_customer: block one or more LiteLLM proxy customers to reject their API calls
create_customer: create a new LiteLLM proxy customer with budget, region, and object permission settings
get_customer_info: retrieve information about a specific LiteLLM proxy customer by end-user ID
update_customer: update an existing LiteLLM proxy customer's budget, region, alias, or object permissions
delete_customer: delete one or more LiteLLM proxy customers by their user IDs
